document: Hungarian tax authority (NAV) receipt, acknowledgement or notification (e.g. filing accepted, card payment confirmed)
glossary: Document type: Hungarian tax authority (NAV) receipt, acknowledgement or notification (e.g. filing accepted, card payment confirmed). Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.document_title: the document title as printed on the document (A nyugta/ertesites cime (pl. Elfogado nyugta, Ertesites sikeres fizetesrol))
field_specs.subject: the subject as printed on the document (Targy/mire vonatkozik (pl. 2353 bevallas beadasa, bankkartyas befizetes))
field_specs.reference_number: the reference number as printed on the document (Iktatoszam / KR erkeztetesi szam / tranzakcio-azonosito, ha szerepel)
field_specs.taxpayer_name: the taxpayer name as printed on the document (Adozo/ugyfel neve)
field_specs.tax_id: the tax id as printed on the document (Adoazonosito jel vagy adoszam, ha szerepel)
field_specs.issue_date: the issue date as printed on the document (Az ertesites/nyugta datuma, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.authority: the authority as printed on the document (Kiallito hatosag (pl. Nemzeti Ado- es Vamhivatal))
field_specs.amount: the amount as printed on the document
